data.title: Tharattazhaku · Celebrate Pregnancy
data.excerpt: Tharattazhaku celebrates expectant mothers through a memorable runway experience, family moments and a community that embraces pregnancy.
data.body:
Tharattazhaku is Kinder Kochi's celebration of pregnancy through a fashion show for expectant mothers. The programme gives mothers-to-be a stage to share confidence, joy and memories with their families and the wider community.

## Season 3 · 2024

The 2024 edition was presented under Kinder Women's Hospital & Fertility Centre. Its invitation reached expectant mothers across India, with a stated goal of more than 100 participants and a record attempt involving more than 101 women. The organisers also announced collaborations with brands, media and experts and described approximately ₹25 lakh in gifts and prizes. These were plans announced for that edition, not current event offers.

## Season 2 · 2023

Around 100 pregnant women took to the runway in the second season. Kinder reports that this event received recognition from the India Book of Records and Asia Book of Records and brought together partner brands, artists and other guests.

## Season 1 · 2022

The first season screened nearly 70 expectant mothers and welcomed 48 to the runway. Kinder reported more than 20 guests and representatives, over 10,000 online and live viewers, and approximately 600 attendees and family members, with coverage across print, television and social media.

## More ways to celebrate

Tharattazhaku has been part of Kinder's wider Celebrate Pregnancy initiative, alongside MomMix cake mixing, the Spandanan music competition, the Kin Baby Bloom baby shower and antenatal classes. Programme dates and activities may change from one season to another.

## Enquire about upcoming events

Contact the Kinder Kochi team to ask about the next Tharattazhaku edition, eligibility, registration and current antenatal programmes. Past season details and prizes are shared here as event history.

data.title: WOW MOM · Kinder Pregnancy Club
data.excerpt: A supportive pregnancy club for learning, wellbeing, friendship and moments worth celebrating at Kinder Kochi.
data.body:
WOW MOM brings expectant mothers together through education, wellbeing activities and celebrations during pregnancy. The club offers a place to connect, ask questions and prepare for birth and the first weeks of parenting.

## Antenatal learning and birth preparation

Classes and expert-led sessions cover prenatal nutrition, fetal development, breastfeeding, labour, pain-management options, newborn care and parenting. Birth-preparation sessions discuss breathing techniques, labour positions and partner support.

## Exercise, wellness and confidence

The club describes pregnancy-appropriate physiotherapy, yoga, Zumba and gentle exercise, alongside grooming, hair and makeup sessions and skincare consultations. Ask the care team which activities are suitable for your pregnancy and currently available.

## Parenting and emotional support

Workshops discuss infant feeding, newborn routines, early baby care and postpartum emotions. Group discussions let members share experiences and concerns in a respectful setting. The programme also describes mental-health support and access to pregnancy-related reading resources.

## Events and shared moments

Baby showers, maternity photography, pregnancy fashion shows, games and other gatherings help members celebrate together. Activity schedules and individual services may vary.

## Joining WOW MOM

The club welcomes expectant mothers. Registration includes contact details so the team can share activity updates. Members are encouraged to participate, respect each other and keep personal stories shared in the group confidential. Ask the Kochi team about current sessions, the registration process and any membership fee.
